Knight.name: Bulwark Oath
Knight.effect: Once per turn, after using Armour Restoration or Fortify, gain Minor Guard Up (+4 Guard) until the start of your next turn.
Knight.trigger: Once per turn after Armour Restoration or Fortify.
Knight.notes: Defensive class hook. Does not create Armour by itself.

Rogue.name: Rogue Tempo
Rogue.effect: Once per turn, if acting before the target, your first Weapon Skill 1 gains +10 Precision. If that skill breaks Armour, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Rogue.trigger: Once per turn; applies to a 2 EN Weapon Skill 1.
Rogue.hook: Weapon Skill 1; Armour break; turn order
Rogue.notes: Replaces the legacy first 1 EN damage bonus.

Mage.name: Arcane Pressure
Mage.effect: The first Magic weapon skill you use each turn deals 10% additional damage to Magic Armour only. This bonus does not increase Health damage.
Mage.trigger: Once per turn on the first Magic weapon skill.
Mage.notes: Encourages breaking Magic Armour without inflating Health damage.

Siren.name: Cursed Call
Siren.effect: Once per turn after you break Magic Armour, the next ailment or stat debuff you apply to that target gains +10 percentage points application chance and lasts 1 additional turn.
Siren.trigger: Once per turn; consumed by the next qualifying ailment or debuff.
Siren.notes: Does not bypass Magic Armour or guarantee application.

Inquisitor.name: Judgement Leech
Inquisitor.effect: Once per turn after a damaging skill hits an ailmented, debuffed or Marked target, restore 2 to the lower of Armour or Magic Armour, capped at its normal maximum. If both pools are full, heal 5% Maximum Health.
Inquisitor.trigger: Once per turn after Health damage to a qualifying target.
Inquisitor.notes: Carrion Mark and other non-stat Marks may qualify when explicitly stated.

Bard.name: Verse and Chorus
Bard.effect: Once per turn, when you alternate Martial and Magic damaging skills, the second skill restores 2 to the lower protection pool. If both pools are full, it gains +10 Skill Power instead.
Bard.trigger: Once per turn on the second skill in a Martial/Magic alternation.
Bard.hook: Hybrid weapons; protection restoration; Skill Power
Bard.notes: The second skill must be a damaging skill.

Brute.name: Crushing Momentum
Brute.effect: Once per turn after Armour absorbs physical damage, your next Strength weapon skill gains +10 Skill Power.
Brute.trigger: Once per turn; consumed on the next Strength weapon skill.

Duke.name: Duke Ascension
Duke.effect: After defeating an enemy, restore 25% of normal Maximum Armour and Magic Armour and gain +5% all damage for the remainder of combat.
Duke.trigger: After each enemy defeated in sequential combat.
Duke.notes: Boss Duke override remains separate: while above 50% Health, +10% damage and 10% less damage taken.

Sparrow.passive: After using Hedge Hop, your next Weapon Skill 1 gains +10 Precision and +5 percentage points Critical Chance.
Sparrow.limit: Once per turn; consumed on the next 2 EN Weapon Skill 1.
Sparrow.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Sparrow.synergy: Light weapons, Shadowplume and early-turn Rogue Tempo.
Sparrow.notes: Starter Rogue loop now points to the 2 EN weapon skill structure.

Hummingbird.passive: After using two different skills in the same turn, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn and restore 1 Magic Armour, capped at its normal maximum.
Hummingbird.limit: Once per turn; repeated copies of the same skill do not count.
Hummingbird.utility: Gain Moderate Agility Up (+10 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Hummingbird.hook: Action chaining; Agility; Magic Armour restoration
Hummingbird.synergy: One-handed weapons, accessories and multi-action turns.
Hummingbird.notes: No longer requires two separate 1 EN actions.

Blackbird.passive: Your first Night Magic weapon skill each turn against a debuffed target gains +10 Skill Power against Magic Armour. If it damages Health, it also gains +10 Precision for its debuff or ailment roll.
Blackbird.limit: Once per turn; the Skill Power bonus applies only to Magic Armour damage.
Blackbird.utility: Apply Minor Resolve Down (-4 Resolve) for 2 turns. This effect is blocked while the target has Magic Armour.
Blackbird.hook: Magic Armour pressure; debuff gate; Skill Power
Blackbird.synergy: Night Wands, Staffs, Runewoven and Nightweave equipment.

Macaw.passive: When Verse and Chorus triggers, the second skill also gains +10 Precision and restores 1 to the lower protection pool, capped at its normal maximum.
Macaw.limit: Once per turn with Verse and Chorus.
Macaw.utility: Copy one Minor positive core-stat effect currently on the enemy until the end of its normal duration; if none exists, gain Minor Focus Up (+4 Focus) for 2 turns.
Macaw.synergy: Bard Song, Talon Blade, Focus Orb and balanced defensive sets.
Macaw.notes: Strengthens the class perk without duplicating its Skill Power reward.

Peregrine Falcon.passive: If acting before the target, your first Finesse Weapon Skill 1 or 2 each turn ignores 4 Guard.
Peregrine Falcon.limit: Once per turn; flat and percentage penetration still follow the normal penetration order.
Peregrine Falcon.utility: Your next weapon skill gains +10 Precision and cannot be redirected.
Peregrine Falcon.hook: Turn order; Finesse weapon skills; flat penetration
Peregrine Falcon.synergy: Dagger Pinion, Talon Blade, Bow and Greatbow.
Peregrine Falcon.notes: Converted percentage Guard ignore into controlled flat penetration.

Snowy Owl.passive: After applying Chilled, your next Magic weapon skill gains +20 Skill Power against Magic Armour.
Snowy Owl.limit: 2-turn cooldown; consumed on hit or miss; bonus does not increase Health damage.
Snowy Owl.utility: Deal 3 Magic Armour damage. If the target has no Magic Armour after the effect, attempt to apply 1 Chilled stack.
Snowy Owl.hook: Magic Armour break; Chilled; Skill Power
Snowy Owl.synergy: Frost-infused Staffs, Orbs and Runewoven equipment.
Snowy Owl.notes: Chilled remains gated by Magic Armour.

Kiwi.passive: Your first physical weapon hit each turn against a debuffed or Marked target ignores 4 Guard.
Kiwi.limit: Once per turn; total penetration remains subject to the normal cap.
Kiwi.utility: Your next attack against a debuffed or Marked target gains +10 Precision and ignores 2 of the matching defence.
Kiwi.synergy: War Scythe, Bell Sceptre hybrids and Judgement Leech.
Kiwi.notes: Supports both debuff and Mark builds.

Black Cockatoo.passive: After using a song or call, your next Magic damaging skill deals 2 additional Magic Armour damage. If it damages Health, apply -10 Precision for 1 turn.
Black Cockatoo.limit: 2-turn cooldown; the debuff remains blocked if Magic Armour was not depleted.
Black Cockatoo.utility: Apply Minor Might Down (-4 Might) and Minor Focus Down (-4 Focus) for 1 turn. This effect is blocked by Magic Armour.
Black Cockatoo.hook: Songs; Magic Armour damage; debuff gate
Black Cockatoo.synergy: Lament Song, Bard Song, Crystalwind and Nightweave.
Black Cockatoo.notes: Replaces generic Damage Down and Precision tier wording.

Crow.passive: Once per turn after Armour absorbs physical damage, your next weapon skill deals 10% additional damage to Armour. If that hit damages Health, it may apply Minor Might Down (-4 Might) for 1 turn.
Crow.limit: Once per turn; the Might debuff requires Armour to be depleted and Health to be damaged.
Crow.utility: Restore 4 Armour, capped at normal Maximum Armour.
Crow.hook: Armour absorption; Armour restoration; protection break
Crow.synergy: Ironfeather, shields, Beak Hammer and Bulwark Oath.

Kookaburra.passive: After successfully applying a stat debuff, your next magical ailment or debuff against that target gains +10 percentage points application chance.
Kookaburra.limit: 2-turn cooldown; does not bypass Magic Armour or recursively trigger Cursed Call.
Kookaburra.utility: Deal 3 Magic Armour damage. If the target has no Magic Armour after the effect, apply -10 Precision for 1 turn.
Kookaburra.synergy: Hexwood Wand, Lament Song and Siren ailment equipment.
Kookaburra.notes: Retains the Gallows Laugh setup identity.

Lyrebird.passive: The first time each combat a song grants Might Up or Focus Up, also gain the other stat at Minor tier (+4) for the same duration and restore 2 Magic Armour.
Lyrebird.limit: Once per combat; only copies Might Up or Focus Up.
Lyrebird.utility: Repeat the last Minor positive core-stat effect you gained until the start of your next turn. If none exists, restore 3 Magic Armour.
Lyrebird.synergy: Bard Song, mixed weapons and Runewoven equipment.

Raven.passive: The first stat debuff you successfully apply each turn also deals 2 Magic Armour damage. If the target already has no Magic Armour, it instead applies -10 Precision for 1 turn.
Raven.limit: Once per turn; strongest Precision Down value applies.
Raven.utility: Apply Minor Focus Down (-4 Focus) for 2 turns. This effect is blocked by Magic Armour.
Raven.synergy: Lament Song, Hexwood Wand and Nightweave.

Magpie.passive: After successfully applying Precision Down, your next Finesse weapon skill gains +10 Skill Power against Armour and +10 Precision.
Magpie.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Magpie.utility: Deal 2 Armour damage. If the target has no Armour after the effect, apply -10 Precision for 1 turn.
Magpie.hook: Armour pressure; Finesse weapon skills; Precision
Magpie.synergy: Dagger Pinion, Talon Blade and Shadowplume.

Robin.passive: After using a support utility, your next Day damaging skill gains +10 Skill Power and restores 2 Magic Armour on hit, capped at its normal maximum.
Robin.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Robin.utility: Heal 10% Maximum Health and restore 2 Magic Armour.
Robin.hook: Support utility; Skill Power; Magic Armour restoration
Robin.synergy: Day weapons, Dawnfeather and Bard support skills.
Robin.notes: Creates a support-to-offence loop without broad Damage Up.

Bowerbird.passive: After using Jewel Display, your next Magic hit deals 2 additional Magic Armour damage. If it damages Health, its ailment or debuff gains +10 percentage points application chance.
Bowerbird.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Bowerbird.utility: Apply Jewel Mark for 2 turns. The Mark has no stat penalty, is not blocked by protection and causes the next qualifying debuff after Magic Armour is broken to gain +10 percentage points application chance.
Bowerbird.hook: Mark; Magic Armour break; debuff setup
Bowerbird.synergy: Focus Orb, Hexwood Wand and Siren equipment.
Bowerbird.notes: Jewel Mark is a Mark, not an ailment.

Toucan.passive: After using a Day action, your next song or call restores 2 to the lower protection pool and gains +10 Precision.
Toucan.utility: Your next damaging skill becomes Day and gains +10 Precision.
Toucan.synergy: Bard Song, Talon Blade and mixed Day loadouts.
Toucan.notes: Supports flexible affinity and hybrid equipment.

Swan.passive: The first time each turn you take damage while above 50% Health, restore 2 Magic Armour, capped at its normal maximum. If Magic Armour is already full, gain Minor Resolve Up (+4 Resolve) until the start of your next turn.
Swan.utility: Gain 6 Ward Magic Armour for 2 turns.
Swan.synergy: Runewoven, Layered Scale and shield builds.

Flamingo.passive: After successfully applying a debuff, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn and restore 1 Magic Armour.
Flamingo.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) and Minor Resolve Up (+4 Resolve) until the start of your next turn.
Flamingo.synergy: Crystalwind, Focus Orb and Siren tempo builds.

Secretary Bird.passive: Once per turn after Armour absorbs physical damage, your next Strength weapon skill gains +10 Skill Power against Armour.
Secretary Bird.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Secretary Bird.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) and +10 Precision until the start of your next turn.
Secretary Bird.notes: Supports a mobile Knight identity without generic Damage Up.

Albatross.passive: After using a Magic action, restore 2 Magic Armour. If Magic Armour is full, gain +10 Precision until the start of your next turn.
Albatross.utility: Cleanse 1 debuff and restore 4 Magic Armour, capped at its normal maximum.
Albatross.synergy: Bell Sceptre, Focus Orb and Dawnfeather.
Albatross.notes: Connects Inquisitor sustain to the new protection pools.

Seagull.passive: After damaging a debuffed or Marked target, restore 1 to the lower protection pool and gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Seagull.utility: Cleanse 1 stat debuff. If a debuff is cleansed, restore 2 to the lower protection pool and gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Seagull.synergy: Light gear, marks and Rogue Tempo.

Goose.passive: The first time each turn Armour absorbs physical damage, restore 1 Armour after the hit, capped at normal Maximum Armour.
Goose.utility: Deal 3 Magic Armour damage. If the effect reaches Health, apply Minor Might Down (-4 Might) for 1 turn.
Goose.hook: Armour absorption; Armour restoration; Magic Armour pressure
Goose.notes: No separate Brute passive or hidden multiplier.

Shoebill Stork.passive: If you did not use a damaging action during your previous turn, your next Strength weapon skill gains +20 Skill Power and deals 2 additional Armour damage.
Shoebill Stork.limit: Consumed on hit or miss; cannot trigger on the first turn.
Shoebill Stork.utility: Gain 4 Fortified Armour and Minor Resolve Up (+4 Resolve) for 1 turn.
Shoebill Stork.synergy: Beak Hammer, Greatblade and heavy equipment.
Shoebill Stork.notes: Patience trades tempo for a stronger Armour-breaking turn.

Harpy Eagle.passive: Your first Finesse weapon skill after using Predator Grip ignores 4 Guard and deals 2 additional Armour damage.
Harpy Eagle.limit: Consumed on hit or miss; penetration remains subject to the normal cap.
Harpy Eagle.utility: Apply Predator Mark for 2 turns. Your attacks gain +10 Precision against the marked target.
Harpy Eagle.notes: Predator Mark is not a stat debuff.

Bald Eagle.passive: After landing a critical hit, restore 2 to the lower protection pool. If both pools are full, gain +10 Precision until the start of your next turn.
Bald Eagle.utility: Gain 4 Fortified Armour and 4 Ward Magic Armour for 1 turn.
Bald Eagle.synergy: Balanced defensive sets and Judgement Leech.
Bald Eagle.notes: Replaces the legacy Barrier with a small dual-pool Aegis.

Emperor Penguin.passive: After successfully applying Chilled, restore 2 Magic Armour. If Magic Armour is full, gain Minor Resolve Up (+4 Resolve) until the start of your next turn.
Emperor Penguin.utility: Gain 6 Ward Magic Armour for 2 turns. The first enemy physical hit while Ward remains deals 2 Magic Armour damage back to the attacker.
Emperor Penguin.synergy: Frost infusion, Runewoven and Judgement Leech.
Emperor Penguin.notes: Retaliation damages protection and does not bypass ailment gates.

Ostrich.passive: After using Momentum Charge, your next Strength weapon skill gains +20 Skill Power and +10 Precision.
Ostrich.limit: Consumed on hit or miss; controlled by the utility cooldown.
Ostrich.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn. Your next Strength weapon skill gains +10 Precision.

Cassowary.passive: Your first Strength weapon skill each turn against a Bleeding or Weakened target gains +10 percentage points Critical Chance and deals 2 additional Armour damage.
Cassowary.limit: Once per turn; condition must be true before the skill resolves.
Cassowary.utility: Deal 3 Armour damage. If it reaches Health, apply Minor Guard Down (-4 Guard) for 1 turn. Your next attack suffers -10 Precision.
Cassowary.hook: Armour damage; Bleed; Critical; Guard debuff
Cassowary.synergy: Beak Hammer, Greatblade and Blood infusion.
Cassowary.notes: Physical debuff requires Armour to be depleted.

Emu.passive: After Armour absorbs physical damage, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn and your next Strength weapon skill gains +10 Precision.
Emu.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn and restore 2 Armour.
Emu.synergy: Heavy weapons with lighter armour variants.

Duke Blakiston.passive: The first time each combat you fall below 50% Health, restore 25% of normal Maximum Armour and Magic Armour and gain Moderate Might Up (+10 Might) and Moderate Focus Up (+10 Focus) for 2 turns.
Duke Blakiston.limit: Once per combat; distinct from Duke Ascension.
Duke Blakiston.utility: Deal 4 Magic Armour damage. If the target has no Magic Armour after the effect, apply Minor Might Down (-4 Might) and Minor Focus Down (-4 Focus) for 1 turn.
Duke Blakiston.synergy: Curated Duke equipment and sequential encounters.
Duke Blakiston.notes: Playable Duke passive remains distinct from the Duke class perk and boss override.

Wren.passive: After you Dodge, your next Weapon Skill 1 gains +10 Precision. If it damages Health, apply -10 Precision to the target for 1 turn.
Wren.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit.
Wren.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn and restore 1 Armour.
Wren.synergy: Dagger Pinion, Shadowplume and Rogue Tempo.
Wren.notes: Basic Attack and Evasion wording removed.

Superb Fairywren.passive: After a Magic damaging skill, your next Finesse damaging skill gains +5 percentage points Critical Chance and restores 1 to the lower protection pool on hit.
Superb Fairywren.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Superb Fairywren.utility: Gain Minor Focus Up (+4 Focus) and Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Superb Fairywren.synergy: Bard Song, Talon Blade and Crystalwind.
Superb Fairywren.notes: Supports Verse and Chorus without duplicating its Skill Power option.

Firecrest.passive: Your first Day damaging skill each turn gains +5 percentage points Critical Chance and deals 2 additional Magic Armour damage.
Firecrest.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn. Your next Day hit attempts to apply 1 Burn stack only if Magic Armour is depleted and Health is damaged.
Firecrest.hook: Magic Armour damage; Burn gate; Critical
Firecrest.synergy: Day weapons, Ember infusion and Rogue Tempo.
Firecrest.notes: Burn remains protected by Magic Armour.

Willie Wagtail.passive: After an enemy attack resolves against you, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn. If you Dodged the attack, also restore 1 Armour.
Willie Wagtail.utility: Deal 2 Armour damage. If the target has no Armour after the effect, apply -10 Precision for 1 turn.
Willie Wagtail.hook: Dodge; Agility; Armour restoration; Armour pressure
Willie Wagtail.synergy: Light shields, Shadowplume and Finesse weapons.

Galah.passive: After using a song or call, restore 2 Magic Armour. If Magic Armour is full, gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn.
Galah.utility: Deal 3 Magic Armour damage. If it reaches Health, apply Minor Might Down (-4 Might) and Minor Focus Down (-4 Focus) for 1 turn.
Galah.hook: Songs; Magic Armour restoration; debuff gate
Galah.synergy: Bard Song, Lament Song and Crystalwind.
Galah.notes: Replaces Evasion and generic Damage Down.

Blue Jay.passive: The first time each turn a Storm damaging skill hits a debuffed or Marked target, gain 3 Ward Magic Armour for 1 turn.
Blue Jay.limit: Once per turn; Ward follows the normal healing and overflow rules.
Blue Jay.utility: Restore 3 Armour and 3 Magic Armour, each capped at its normal maximum.
Blue Jay.synergy: Storm weapons, Layered Scale and Judgement Leech.

Cardinal.passive: Your first Day Magic weapon skill each turn against a Burning target gains +20 Skill Power against Magic Armour. If it damages Health, heal 5% Maximum Health.
Cardinal.limit: Once per turn; the Skill Power bonus does not increase Health damage.
Cardinal.utility: Heal 8% Maximum Health and restore 3 Magic Armour.

Bush Turkey.passive: Once per turn, an Armour Restoration or Fortify skill you use grants 1 additional Armour.
Bush Turkey.limit: Once per turn; the additional point follows the original skill's normal cap or overflow rule.
Bush Turkey.notes: Armour Technique and Brace wording removed.

Vulture.passive: While the target is below 50% Health, gain +10 Precision. The first time each turn you damage that target's Health, restore 1 to the lower protection pool.
Vulture.limit: Condition is checked before each action; restoration is once per turn.
Vulture.utility: Cleanse 1 damaging ailment and restore 4 to the protection pool that normally blocks that ailment.
Vulture.hook: Execute pressure; cleansing; matching protection restoration
Vulture.synergy: War Scythe, marks and Judgement Leech.
Vulture.notes: Physical ailments restore Armour; magical ailments restore Magic Armour.

Barn Owl.passive: If acting before the target, your first Night Magic weapon skill each turn gains +5 percentage points Critical Chance and deals 2 additional Magic Armour damage.
Barn Owl.utility: Gain Minor Agility Up (+4 Agility) until the start of your next turn. Your next Night attack gains +10 Precision.
Barn Owl.hook: Turn order; Magic Armour pressure; Critical

Bustard.passive: While below 50% Health, restoring Armour or gaining Fortify also grants Minor Might Up (+4 Might) until the start of your next turn.
Bustard.utility: Gain 6 Fortified Armour for 2 turns and cleanse Agility Down.

Golden Eagle.passive: Your first damaging skill each turn against a target below 50% Health gains +10 percentage points Critical Chance and deals 2 additional damage to the matching protection pool.
Golden Eagle.limit: Once per turn; condition must be true before the skill.
Golden Eagle.utility: Your next damaging skill gains +10 percentage points Critical Chance.
Golden Eagle.synergy: Greatbow, Talon Blade and offensive accessories.
Golden Eagle.notes: Uses matching Armour or Magic Armour according to the skill.

Australian Pelican.passive: After using a Water action, restore 2 Armour. Your next Strength weapon hit may apply Minor Might Down (-4 Might) only if Armour is depleted and Health is damaged.
Australian Pelican.limit: 2-turn cooldown; the debuff is consumed on the next Strength hit.
Australian Pelican.utility: Heal 8% Maximum Health, cleanse 1 debuff and restore 4 to the lower protection pool.
Australian Pelican.hook: Armour restoration; Water action; physical debuff gate
Australian Pelican.synergy: Heavy Water weapons, Layered Scale and Crushing Momentum.
Australian Pelican.notes: Replaces generic Bastion wording with explicit protection effects.

Marabou Stork.passive: Your first damaging action each turn against a target below 50% Health gains +10 Skill Power. If it damages Health, restore 2 to the lower protection pool.
Marabou Stork.utility: Apply Carrion Mark for 2 turns. It counts as a qualifying Mark for Judgement Leech but has no stat penalty and is not blocked by protection.
Marabou Stork.hook: Execute; Mark; protection restoration; Skill Power
Marabou Stork.synergy: War Scythe, Focus Orb and Judgement Leech.
Marabou Stork.notes: Carrion Mark remains a Mark rather than an ailment.

Pigeon.passive: After using a support utility, your next Earth damaging skill gains +10 Skill Power and restores 1 to the lower protection pool on hit.
Pigeon.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Pigeon.utility: Restore 3 Armour and 3 Magic Armour, each capped at its normal maximum.
Pigeon.hook: Support utility; Skill Power; dual restoration
Pigeon.synergy: Layered Scale, Bard Song and Earth weapons.
Pigeon.notes: Brace and generic Damage Up wording removed.

Rock Pigeon.passive: After restoring Armour or gaining Fortify, your next Earth hit deals 2 additional Armour damage. If it damages Health, apply Minor Guard Down (-4 Guard) for 1 turn.
Rock Pigeon.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit.
Rock Pigeon.utility: Restore 4 Armour and gain Minor Resolve Up (+4 Resolve) until the start of your next turn.
Rock Pigeon.hook: Armour restoration; Fortify; Armour damage; Guard debuff
Rock Pigeon.synergy: Ironfeather, Layered Scale and Earth weapons.
Rock Pigeon.notes: Barrier and Brace Down wording removed.

Dove.passive: The first support or song skill you use each turn restores 2 Magic Armour. If Magic Armour is full, gain Minor Resolve Up (+4 Resolve) until the start of your next turn.
Dove.utility: Cleanse 1 debuff and gain 6 Ward Magic Armour for 2 turns.

Rock Dove.passive: After Armour absorbs physical damage, your next song or call restores 3 Armour, capped at its normal maximum.
Rock Dove.limit: Once per turn; consumed when the song or call resolves.
Rock Dove.synergy: Layered Scale, Ironfeather and Bard support builds.
Rock Dove.notes: Brace and generic Damage Down wording removed.

Kakapo.passive: While below 50% Health, the first song you use restores 2 to the lower protection pool and heals 5% Maximum Health.
Kakapo.limit: 3-turn cooldown; does not trigger from Moss Dream.
Kakapo.utility: Heal 8% Maximum Health and restore 3 Magic Armour.
Kakapo.synergy: Dawnfeather, defensive songs and Verse and Chorus.
Kakapo.notes: Sustain is split between Health and protection.

Dodo.passive: The first time each combat your Armour reaches 0 while below 50% Health, restore 4 Armour and gain Minor Guard Up (+4 Guard) until the start of your next turn.
Dodo.utility: Gain 8 Fortified Armour for 2 turns. While Fortify remains, suffer Minor Agility Down (-4 Agility).
Dodo.notes: Replaces generic damage reduction and the legacy Barrier.

Chickadee.passive: After using Pine Cover, your next Weapon Skill 1 gains +10 Skill Power and +10 Precision.
Chickadee.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Chickadee.utility: Restore 3 Armour and 3 Magic Armour, each capped at its normal maximum.
Chickadee.synergy: Dagger Pinion, Shadowplume and Rogue Tempo.
Chickadee.notes: No longer tied to a 1 EN Martial action.

Finch.passive: After using Natural Strike, your next Earth Weapon Skill 1 or 2 gains +10 Skill Power and restores 1 Armour on hit.
Finch.limit: Once per turn; consumed on hit or miss.
Finch.utility: Deal 2 Armour damage. If the target has no Armour after the effect, apply Minor Agility Down (-4 Agility) for 1 turn.
Finch.hook: Natural Strike; weapon skills; Armour restoration; Armour pressure
Finch.synergy: Earth Talon Blade, Bow and light defensive sets.
Finch.notes: Basic Attack wording standardised to Natural Strike.
